ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text:
During the ripening process of banana fruit, the stored substances in the fruit are continuously metabolized and transformed, and the banana gradually becomes sweeter. In Figure A, the two curves I and II respectively indicate the change trends of the contents of two substances during the ripening process of banana fruit. Please answer:
Take equal amounts of banana pulp ripened to day X and day Y, and add equal amounts of distilled water respectively to make extracts. Then add 5 mL of the extract from day X to each of test tubes a and b, and add 5 mL of the extract from day Y to each of test tubes c and d, as shown in Figure B. It is known that ethephon can increase the content of ethylene inside cells. If ethephon is sprayed on day X, from day X onward, will curve I show a trend of accelerated decline or slowed decline? Will curve II show a trend of accelerated rise or slowed rise?

Please answer: Take equal amounts of banana pulp ripened to day X and day Y, and add equal amounts of distilled water respectively to make extracts. Then add 5 mL of the extract from day X to each of test tubes a and b, and add 5 mL of the extract from day Y to each of test tubes c and d, as shown in Figure B. Will curve II show a trend of accelerated rise or slowed rise?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In Figure A, the vertical axis is “contents of two substances,” and the horizontal axis is “ripening time (d).” Curve I has a relatively high content in the early stage of ripening, and then continuously declines as ripening time increases; curve II has a relatively low content in the early stage, and then continuously rises as ripening time increases. X is at an earlier ripening stage, and Y is at a later ripening stage. In Figure B, test tubes a and b are added with banana extract from day X, and test tubes c and d are added with banana extract from day Y, and it shows that iodine solution, Fehling’s reagent, etc. may be added to detect substance changes. Then reason: The question stem states that during the ripening process of banana, stored substances are continuously metabolized and transformed, and the banana gradually becomes sweeter; ethephon can increase the ethylene content inside cells, and ethylene has the function of promoting fruit ripening. Therefore, after ethephon is sprayed on day X, the ripening process of the banana will speed up; during ripening, the content change of the substance that originally declined will decline faster, and the content change of the substance that originally rose will rise faster. Therefore, curve I declines faster, and curve II rises faster.
